sources.title: Circuit and physical design of the POWER6 microprocessor
sources.venue_or_publication: IBM Journal of Research and Development
sources.what_it_covers: POWER6 65nm high-frequency physical design, power-grid, clock-grid, timing closure and noise challenges
sources.why_relevant: Detailed IBM war story on power-grid and clock design failure modes and recovery for a >4GHz ASIC, direct analog to closure failures
sources.verification_hint: IBM JRD vol 51 no 6 2007 POWER6 circuit physical design

sources.title: Physical design and design closure of the zEnterprise EC12 processor
sources.venue_or_publication: IBM Journal of Research and Development
sources.what_it_covers: z196 / zEC12 mainframe processor floorplanning, congestion, power, timing closure
sources.why_relevant: Classic IBM mainframe closure war story with quantitative congestion and power-grid fixes
sources.verification_hint: IBM JRD 56 1/2 2012 z196 physical design closure

sources.title: POWER8 processor circuit and physical design
sources.venue_or_publication: IBM Journal of Research and Development
sources.what_it_covers: 22nm SOI POWER8 core physical design, wire-dominated timing, CTS and power-grid recovery
sources.why_relevant: Successor to owned POWER4 papers, explicitly discusses timing closure and power-grid iterations
sources.verification_hint: IBM JRD 58 5/6 2014 POWER8 circuit physical design

sources.title: The AMD Zen Core: A High-Performance x86 Core Architecture and Its Physical Implementation
sources.what_it_covers: Zen 14nm floorplan, congestion, clock distribution, and design closure lessons
sources.why_relevant: Public Hot Chips talk with real failure-recovery anecdotes on congestion and timing closure in a modern high-performance ASIC
sources.verification_hint: Hot Chips 28 2016 AMD Zen presentation Sullivan Clark

sources.title: Piton: A Manycore Processor for Open Source and Education – Tape-out and Bring-up Lessons
sources.what_it_covers: 25-core Piton 32nm tape-out, power-grid droop, CTS bugs, silicon bring-up debug
sources.why_relevant: Academic open-source ASIC with explicit failure-and-recovery narrative for physical design and silicon bring-up
sources.verification_hint: ASPLOS 2015 Piton Balfour et al Princeton tape-out
